description: Source code for a C module handling TR-069/WMP protocol requests and responses, including parsing, formulating responses, and memory management functions.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_generic_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON payload to extract request details based on command type.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_request
methods.description: Wrapper for parsing request with default payload type WDMP_TR181.

methods.name: wdmp_form_response
methods.description: Creates a JSON response payload based on response object.

methods.name: wdmp_free_req_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for request structures.

methods.name: wdmp_free_res_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for response structures.
